module: A2-M11 How Much / How Many · P1
scenario: How many + plural countable noun + do/does?
en: How many apples do you need?
ipa: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈæpəlz duː juː nid/
trPron: Hav meni epılz du yu nid
collocations: how many apples, apples do you need
commonMistake: How much apples do you need? ❌
aiExplain: Curious"How many" sayılabilir çoğul isimlerle (apples) kullanılır. Kaç tane sorusu sorar.
